raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely fixed 11 February 1929 (the signing of the Lateran Treaty) as the exact date Vatican City became an independent state, ignoring that reputable sources (e.g., Britannica surfaced later by WebSurfer) note the treaty became effective upon ratification on 7 June 1929. By anchoring to the signing date and repeatedly directing searches to confirm it, the Planner led the team toward the wrong date for when the place of death became its own country.
